# Autonomy Labs Storefront — Full Agent Documentation

Autonomy Labs sells digital downloads and made-to-order browser prototypes for small business owners and AI agents. After verified payment, configured downloads are sent by email; custom services follow the delivery window on their landing page. No subscription or login is required.

## What this site offers

This is an AI-agent-discoverable product storefront. AI agents and humans can browse the catalog, click a Stripe payment link, pay by card, and receive configured downloads by email after verified payment. Made-to-order prototypes are built to the buyer's brief within the stated delivery window.

## Purchase flow

1. Click a Stripe payment link.
2. Pay with card (Stripe handles checkout).
3. After verified payment, digital products are sent to the customer email by the configured fulfillment webhook; made-to-order services follow the delivery window on their landing page.

## Paid LLM API (x402, USDC on Base)

Autonomy Labs also sells paid LLM completions over the x402 payment protocol (USDC on Base, network eip155:8453). No API key, no subscription: pay per call on-chain, then POST the order and signature to receive the completion.

Public base URL: https://creating-century-fellowship-matched.trycloudflare.com

Products:
- `llm` — llama3.1:8b, up to 500 tokens — $0.05 USDC
- `llm-plus` — up to 4096 tokens — $0.20 USDC

Payment flow:
1. `GET https://creating-century-fellowship-matched.trycloudflare.com/api/llm?product=llm` returns a 402 invoice (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) with the exact amount and payee (0x7e0190af0951485dFd08bE2FE19Fa638e94F426D).
2. Transfer the invoiced USDC on Base to the payee address.
3. `POST https://creating-century-fellowship-matched.trycloudflare.com/api/llm?product=llm` with JSON `{order, signature, prompt, product}`; the completion is returned after the transfer is verified on-chain.

## Agent interoperability

- **Payment:** Stripe Checkout (card). No API key required to buy.
- **Fulfillment:** automatic email delivery via webhook for downloads; made-to-order services follow their stated delivery windows.
- **x402 paywall endpoint:** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/.well-known/x402
- **Agent card (A2A, agent-card.json):** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json — agent identity, capabilities, and endpoints for agent-to-agent discovery
- **Agent actions manifest (agents.json):** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/.well-known/agents.json — endpoints + workflows (buy-product, run-free-audit)
- **Agent readme:** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/agents.txt
- **Sitemap:** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- **Robots:** https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/robots.txt
- **Free tools for agents and site owners:** llms.txt generator (https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/llms-generator.html), llms-validator (https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/llms-validator.html), free readiness audit API (GET https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/api/audit?url=<site>)
- **Open source (MIT):** https://github.com/Autonomy-Labs-Tech (agent-readiness-audit, llms-validator, taskmarket-mcp, ai-storefront-discovery-kit, prompt-vault, llms-txt-hub fork)
